assets.title: Open Oven Play Kitchen
assets.description: One original static play-kitchen visual assembly: a continuous shared cabinet and rear upstand on four complete feet, one pierced continuous counter, a true deep independently rim-seated basin, two fixed annular countertop marks, an empty oven with a finite supported shelf, and an open storage bay with its own shelf. A thick 90-degree side-open door has a genuine through-window and integral full-bore ears. Two complete headed square pins pass through the aligned body and door ears; complete ear underseats, head seats and two integral fixed stops support the single pose. An original short solid-ended spout is decorative and blind. All geometry newly authored as one prop, no old stove/sink scaling or furniture assembly. Metres, native Z up, front -Y, horizontal bounds-centred ground origin. Constant opaque PBR only: no TEX_* nodes, linked Principled inputs, texture, text, branding, transparency or animation. Static visual appearance only. No heating, water supply/drainage, electricity, cooking, door/knob interaction, child scale/age suitability, pinch or swallowing protection, food/material safety, load/anti-tip, manufacturing, toy/child safety certification or old-asset compatibility claim.
